findings.description: The code reads two bits from an I2C register and casts the result directly to an enum (`HUSB238_5VCurrentContract`). If the value read is not a valid enum value, this can lead to undefined behavior or logic errors.
The code assumes that `contractABits.read()` will always succeed and return a valid value. If the I2C communication fails, the returned value may be invalid.
If the enum is later used in a way that exposes internal state or error codes, improper handling could lead to information disclosure.
